changes: Added all six equipment slots: hands, shields, legs and both accessory slots, with 224 new items.
Slot 3 now holds either a hands piece or an off-hand weapon, and the same accessory cannot be worn twice.
Merged the Weapon and Armor tabs into one Equipment workspace with a six-slot loadout.
Added search to every equipment list, matching name, effect text, material and weapon scaling.
Added equipment set bonuses: 13 sets, showing which thresholds a loadout has reached and what the next one grants.
Hands, legs and accessories now take materials and enchantments, resolved per slot rather than borrowing the torso's values.
Added Blunt, Pierce and Slash resistance, from armour, materials, enchantments, items and Installed Youkai.
Items now contribute elemental resistance and maximum HP/FP that they previously only described in text.
Dragon King and Dragon Queen are counted from the pieces you have equipped instead of a number typed into Advanced.
Fixed ranged item bonuses such as "+2-4 CEL", which were applied as penalties; they are now adjustable to the roll your item has.
Fixed bonus Aptitude from equipment counting toward the every-6-Aptitude stat bonus.
Fixed Brightray Plate's Darkness resistance, which never applied.
